context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 fix verified: per-edit-row final_spots exactly matches schedule_rows count across all mixes and with row_overrides. If the user reports schedule mismatches again, first check whether the input contains duplicate plan-lines and whether occ_key in server.py still includes _row_id. Note two pre-existing test files need attention: (1) backend_test.py::TestLearnSample requires /tmp/samples/output.xlsx which does not exist; (2) test_iteration4.py has a deprecated class-scoped instance-method fixture warning.
rca of the issue: Root cause (from iter14 investigation) was that the input xlsx has DUPLICATE plan-rows for the same (channel, program, timeband) — e.g. two rows for 'Colors Kannada / Gowri Kalyana (R)/ FTB / 10:30-11:00'. When occ_key was (channel, program, start, end, edit_duration) the second row starved because the first exhausted the slot pool. Fix in server.py generate_plan changed occ_key to (_row_id, edit_duration) so each plan-line has its own independent capacity per edit. Verification: on the sample input, all 5616 requested spots across every edit mix (10-heavy, 30-heavy, balanced, single, with overrides) are now scheduled with zero drops.
